top_signals.title: Mexico Touts Improving CDS as Bonds Trade as Speculative Grade
top_signals.summary: Mexico cited improving spreads in the credit-default swaps market as a sign of its good standing in debt markets, where investors have sent its bonds trading more in line with speculative-grade nations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: Federal judge lifts final block on Trump mail-in voting order, clearing way for midterm restrictions
top_signals.summary: The rule in question would require election officials to give USPS voter information and use federally reviewed, uniquely barcoded ballot envelopes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
